instruction: I need to watch this online video in VLC media player: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bZkp7q19f0

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Gangnam Style). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type) to verify the correct video is playing. Task difficulty remains identical to the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric parameter handling is CORRECT: directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] (lines 72-73 in tmp_funcs/vlc.py), which is the correct pattern when expected.type='rule'
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks both VLC playing state (line 27-28) AND correct video verification via URL/video ID matching
YouTube video ID extraction logic is robust: extracts video ID '9bZkp7q19f0' from expected URL and searches for it in VLC metadata (lines 104-114)

Multiple verification strategies implemented: (1) Direct URL matching (lines 94-101), (2) YouTube video ID matching (lines 104-114), (3) Domain/path matching for non-YouTube URLs (lines 129-142), (4) Filename extraction for HLS streams (lines 145-154)
Correctly returns 0 (failure) when no match is found (line 157), preventing false positives
Title field is inspected for debugging (lines 118-126) but correctly does NOT return success without video ID match, preventing acceptance of wrong videos
The evaluator will correctly reject scenarios where user opens a different YouTube video or any other video instead of the specific Gangnam Style video (9bZkp7q19f0)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to handle edge cases where VLC might close or stop playing after task completion, though current config already launches VLC which should persist during evaluation
Enhancement: Could add explicit video title verification as an additional check if video ID matching fails, though current video ID approach is already robust for YouTube URLs
